degree_rationale: Wisdom unfolding from the First Father into all gifts: Mother of Life as origin of blessings, Ambassador of counsels, Beloved of honors, First Man of warriors, Living Spirit of architects, Virgin of wisdoms, Mind of Light as awakener. Essence-source of every celestial faculty.
direction_rationale: Unfolding wisdom — each beautiful thing traced back to its luminous origin. South is the noon where each celestial principle is seen in its full splendor.
grand_man_function: Celestial wisdom-fountain — the inmost from which every gift, blessing, and counsel proceeds.
title: How wisdom unfolds from the First Father into the cosmos
